# codex-1-tty report

- Seed: 103 (the requested `codex-1` attempt with seed 101 stopped at the title screen; this retry used the same procedure in TTY mode).
- Character: Dunadan Warrior, level 1, 21/21 HP at stop.
- Depth: 1; final turn 1860; 66 answered screens / 67 asks recorded; 255 keypresses.
- End: voluntarily ended in town, alive, with 134 gold and carried value 466.

## What happened

The game drew Dunadan Warrior. I accepted the recommended point-based stats and entered the dungeon from the town staircase. Three depth-1 layouts were surveyed. None exposed a down staircase in the explored area. The first layout was a compact dead end; the second exposed a grey mold, whose spores reduced HP from 21 to 16; the third had a larger room and a southern wall/passage structure but still no visible descent. I returned to town after each survey.

## Decisions to take back

- Around asks 8–29 (turns 1–690), I spent too many moves navigating town without finding a shop entrance. A better test would be to use the map coordinates more systematically or accept descending without shopping.
- At asks 44–46 (turns 1030–1100), I approached the grey mold before having a ranged attack. I should have left that branch sooner; the evidence was the message “The grey mold releases spores at you” and HP falling to 16/21.
- I did not buy the Warrior’s recommended oil, healing, or Phase Door. The run therefore could not test the manual’s early ranged-attack policy.

## Manual gaps and leads

- Lead: shallow depth-1 levels can be extremely compact and may lack an immediately visible down staircase. Evidence: three fresh layouts at turns 690, 850, and 1360; no `>` was found. Test with more seeds and a systematic full-map sweep.
- Lead: rerolling by returning to town and descending produced a different layout. Evidence: the first and second depth-1 maps differed after the turn-850 return and turn-1360 descent. Test whether repeated rerolls are consistently more productive than searching one layout.
- Lead: grey mold can damage a level-1 Warrior without melee contact. Evidence: turn 1060 message “The grey mold releases spores at you,” HP 21→16. Test at greater distance with oil and record the safe range.

## Visibility and capability limits

The screen showed only the currently lit and explored dungeon area; no full unseen-level map was available. I could not determine whether the layouts had a down staircase beyond the explored boundary without taking more risky moves. The first non-TTY frontend attempt also blocked after the title screen; TTY mode advanced normally.
